room_rent.note: Policy wording does not specify a room rent cap. Co-payment structure references 'Shared Accommodation' (15% copay) vs 'Single occupancy or higher' (30% copay), implying room choice is unrestricted but drives copay level.

icu.note: ICU charges are listed as covered under In-patient Treatment with no stated sub-limit.

copayment.display: 15% (shared room) / 30% (single/higher room); 30% for listed illnesses/surgeries; 15% for day care
copayment.note: Mandatory copay on every claim: 15% if shared accommodation, 30% if single occupancy or higher. Exception: 15% applies for acute cardiac/accident in single room if shared unavailable. 30% copay for 14 listed illnesses/surgeries (cataract, hysterectomy, cholecystectomy, TURP, hernia, angiography, arthroscopy, PID-discectomy, mastectomy, joint replacement, PTCA, hydrocele, major organ transplant, CABG). Day care: 15% flat. If illness-specific 30% copay applies, accommodation copay does not stack.

sub_limits.display: 30% copay on 14 procedures (cataract, joint replacement, CABG, etc.)
sub_limits.note: No fixed rupee sub-limits stated, but 30% mandatory copay acts as an effective cap on 14 listed illnesses/surgeries including cataract, joint replacement, PTCA, CABG, major organ transplant, hysterectomy, cholecystectomy, hernia, hydrocele, mastectomy, arthroscopy, angiography, TURP, PID-discectomy.

initial_waiting.note: Endorsement option available to delete this waiting period entirely.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 24 or 12 months via endorsement)
ped_waiting.note: Base is 36 months. Endorsements allow reduction to 24 months or 12 months, or full deletion. Best achievable is deletion (0 months) but lowest stated option is 12 months.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (reducible to 12 months or deleted via endorsement)
specific_disease_waiting.note: Base is 24 months for listed conditions. Endorsements allow reduction to 12 months or full deletion.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy offers a 5% non-cumulative discount on renewal premium after each claim-free year. This is a premium discount, not a sum insured bonus. No cumulative SI bonus described.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered; 15% copay applies.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary treatment covered for periods exceeding 3 days where hospitalisation is not possible or room unavailable.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered in recognised AYUSH hospitals. Out-patient AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered. Donor's pre/post-hospitalisation expenses excluded.

ambulance.note: Emergency ambulance only; non-emergency and non-registered providers excluded.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit.

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, etc.) are listed as non-medical expenses and excluded. In-patient treatment definition mentions consumables but the non-medical expenses annexure excludes them.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for non-monthly payment modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (except ectopic), congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, sleep apnoea investigation, OPD treatment, hearing aids/spectacles, vaccination, non-medical expenses, treatment outside India
optional_riders: Waiting period waivers via endorsement (30-day, 24-month specific disease, 36-month PED — reducible or deletable)
